messages:
anita: Heads-up: EdgeBridge (HW + SI) asked for a private marketplace offer bundling our Dedicated credits + their appliance rebate. They want a joint announcement timed with their annual partner day (2026-10-05). Need commit tiers, SKUs, renewal mechanics, and a short co-branded blurb. Who can own?
sam: I can draft tiers. leaning 12-mo commit with quarterly true-ups; offer optional 24-mo locked-price for enterprise.
dave: Sales request: 60-day enrollment credit (applies to months 1-2) to accelerate Q4 pipeline. Also propose a renewal accelerator: 5% one-time credit if customer renews within final 90d.
maria: Ops: Marketplace listing must reference "partner-managed rebate" and link to private-offer redemption URL. Pass-through requires partner PO + SOW. Also need SKU names and billing cadence.
legal-bot: Do not promise HW rebate in public copy. Add auto-renew opt-out and export control clause. Will draft redlines.
sam: Draft commit bands (USD, 12-mo):
- Starter: $6k/mo -> 6% discount, no HW rebate
- Growth: $50k/mo -> 15% discount + $20k HW rebate pass-through + 60-day enrollment credit (months 1-2)
- Enterprise: $180k/mo -> 24% discount + $70k HW rebate pass-through + 2-week fast-start onboarding credit
Optional 24-mo lock -> additional 3% discount; quarterly true-up; enrollment credit applied as invoice credit.
dave: Keep fast-start as add-on for Growth, included for Enterprise. Sales happy.
maria: Suggested SKUs: rwd-edgebridge-starter-v1, rwd-edgebridge-growth-v1, rwd-edgebridge-enterprise-v1, rwd-edgebridge-faststart-2w. Marketplace copy: neutral, link to partner PO + private-offer URL.
anita: Assignments: Sam -> finalize pricing spreadsheet + private-offer JSON; Dave -> field one-pager + enrollment calc; Maria -> SKU registration + listing draft; Legal -> redlines for marketplace T&Cs. I'll coordinate co-branded blurb with comms.
legal-bot: Also recommend explicit price-protection window of 90 days post-renewal and 30-day cancellation window for multi-year commitments.
dave: Noted. I'll include messaging for field: how rebates pass-through, SOW prerequisites, and displacement rules for existing cloud credits.
ops-bot: Proposed timeline saved: internal announce 2026-09-28, public + partner press 2026-10-05. Confirm by EOD next Tue to hit partner day.
anita: Thanks team. Ping me @anita for any blockers. :rocket:
